sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM sales_orders
SELECT sum(total_amount) AS total FROM sales_orders
SELECT to_char(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, sum(total_amount) AS total FROM sales_orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT s.name AS loja, sum(o.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT s.name AS loja, count(*) AS n FROM sales_orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT p.name AS produto, sum(l.line_total) AS total FROM order_lines l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT c.name AS categoria, sum(l.line_total) AS total FROM order_lines l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT avg(total_amount) AS ticket FROM sales_orders
SELECT s.name AS loja, avg(o.total_amount) AS ticket FROM sales_orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM customers
SELECT state AS estado, count(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY 1
SELECT c.name AS categoria, count(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY 1

pergunta: Faturamento por mês da loja Downtown
sql: SELECT to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, sum(o.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE s.name = 'Downtown' GROUP BY 1
SELECT sum(total_amount) AS total FROM sales_orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-04-01'

pergunta: Quantidade de itens vendidos por mês
sql: SELECT to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, sum(l.quantity) AS itens FROM order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT s.state AS estado, sum(o.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT s.name AS loja, sum(o.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
